verdict.rationale: Atlassian's feature page claims 'Rich APIs', and independent users confirm driving Jira programmatically: they wrote API wrapper scripts to submit bug reports and run queries via REST. The OpenAPI probe 404s only show no spec at the tried root paths, which does not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party API reference documentation in the evidence, and a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt for AI-native consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: I ended up writing some simple Jira API wrapper scripts for submitting bug reports quicker in our systems.
